svg.title: The eight chapters and their recorded uses of one another
svg.desc: Eight chapters on a ring around the grammar, sized by their results (The root 86, The map 94, Knowing and testing 110, Life and evolution 46, Collectives and selection 74, The classical texts 16, Significance and alignment 82, Method and the formal core 21); 497 formal-reuse uses between chapters, 17 pairs with at least 10 drawn; the continuation condition and C come into chapter 7 as premises, each a hypothesis where used, neither asserted; T1 to T8 at their homes, coloured by test outcome.
